title: GraphNode
description: One node in the deterministically generated PROGRAM-003 Knowledge Graph index. Every GraphNode is produced by scripts/trader_intelligence/build_graph.py from exactly one authoritative Trader Intelligence source file. GraphNode records are never hand-authored and never authoritative -- the source file named in sourceFile always remains the ground truth. Rebuilding from unchanged source files must reproduce byte-identical GraphNode records.

generated.description: Always true. Marks this record as a build artifact, never as an authoritative research record.

nodeId.description: Format: NODE|{NODE_TYPE}|{entityId}. Fully deterministic from the source entity's own id -- never a random UUID.

nodeType.description: CONCEPT is intentionally excluded -- deferred until real primary-source terminology exists to normalize.

entityId.description: The source entity's own id, copied exactly as it appears in its authoritative file (e.g. traderId, strategyFamilyId, ruleId, questionId, decisionId).

traderId.description: Present whenever the source entity is trader-scoped. Null only for entities that genuinely carry no traderId field (none exist among the required node types today, but the field stays optional for forward compatibility).

label.description: Human-readable label derived from the source entity's own displayName/name/title/question/etc. field -- never independently authored by the builder.

status.description: Mirrors the source entity's own lifecycle/status field where one exists (e.g. a STRATEGY_RULE node mirrors modelingStatus); 'active' for entities with no native lifecycle field.

sourceFile.description: Repo-relative path this node was generated from. This is what makes the graph auditable and rebuildable.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest over the canonical serialization of the source entity's JSON at build time (see scripts/trader_intelligence/build_graph.py:canonical_json). This is the staleness signal.

createdAt.description: Copied verbatim from the source entity's own createdAt field when present, else the ISO date this node was first generated. Never the current build's wall-clock time -- that would break rebuild determinism.

updatedAt.description: Copied verbatim from the source entity's own updatedAt field when present.

metadata.description: Small, optional passthrough of source-entity fields not otherwise promoted to first-class node fields. Kept minimal by convention -- not a dumping ground.
